# Kition Support

Choose the channel that matches your request so maintainers can respond with
the right context.

## Bug Reports

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
for reproducible problems in the public Kition client. Search existing issues
first and include the Kition version, operating system, reproduction steps,
and expected behavior.

Remove workspace content, credentials, tokens, private runtime details, and
other personal information from logs and screenshots before posting them.

## Feature Requests

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
for focused improvements that can be discussed through public client behavior
and contracts.

## Product And Account Help

Email `support@kition.ai` for account, billing, installation, or private
workspace questions that should not be discussed in a public issue.

## Security Reports

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Follow the
[security policy](SECURITY.md) and use GitHub private vulnerability reporting.

## Contribution Help

Questions about local setup, repository scope, testing, or pull requests should
start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
[development standard](../docs/development-standard.md).
